# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Signac)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(Matrix)
  library(data.table)
})

SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()   
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")                     
DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
```

# 2. Parameters
```{r parameters}
seurat_rds    <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_RNA_ATAC_chr123.rds")
celltype_col  <- "cell_type_manual"
celltypes_tsv    <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "celltypes.tsv")
window_bp     <- 500000L
min_peak_frac <- 0.0
min_gene_frac <- 0.0
keep_chr      <- c("chr1","chr2","chr3")
```

# 3. Loop
```{r}
message("Reading cell types...")
keys_df <- read.delim(celltypes_tsv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE)
stopifnot("celltype_key" %in% names(keys_df))
keys <- unique(trimws(keys_df$celltype_key))
keys <- keys[!is.na(keys) & nzchar(keys)]
if (!length(keys)) stop("No valid cell types found in ", celltypes_tsv)
message("Will run for cell types: ", paste(keys, collapse = ", "))


seo <- readRDS(seurat_rds)

for (key in keys){
  message("processing:", key)
  stopifnot(celltype_col %in% colnames(seo[[]]))
  cells_ct <- rownames(subset(seo, subset = !!as.name(celltype_col) == key)[[]])
  if (length(cells_ct) == 0) stop("No cells found for cell type: ", key)
  atac_counts <- GetAssayData(seo, assay = "ATAC", slot = "counts")[, cells_ct, drop = FALSE]
  peak_ids    <- rownames(seo[["ATAC"]])
  if (is.null(peak_ids) || length(peak_ids) == 0) stop("No peak rownames in ATAC assay.")
  peak_gr     <- StringToGRanges(peak_ids, sep = c("-", "-"))
  names(peak_gr) <- peak_ids
  
  if (!is.null(keep_chr)) {
    peak_gr <- peak_gr[as.character(seqnames(peak_gr)) %in% keep_chr]
    atac_counts <- atac_counts[rownames(atac_counts) %in% names(peak_gr), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  rna_counts <- GetAssayData(seo, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")[, cells_ct, drop = FALSE]
  
  peak_frac   <- Matrix::rowMeans(atac_counts > 0)
  keep_peaks  <- names(peak_frac)[peak_frac >= min_peak_frac]
  peaks_ct    <- peak_gr[keep_peaks]
  
  annot   <- Annotation(seo[["ATAC"]])
  tss_gr  <- resize(annot, width = 1, fix = "start")
  names(tss_gr) <- make.unique(sub("\\..*$","", mcols(annot)$gene_id))
  if (!is.null(keep_chr)) tss_gr <- tss_gr[as.character(seqnames(tss_gr)) %in% keep_chr]
  
  gene_frac      <- Matrix::rowMeans(rna_counts > 0)
  rna_ids        <- sub("\\..*$","", rownames(rna_counts))
  keep_gene_ids  <- rna_ids[gene_frac >= min_gene_frac]
  tss_ct         <- tss_gr[intersect(keep_gene_ids, names(tss_gr))]
  
  message("kept peaks: ", length(peaks_ct))
  message("kept genes: ", length(tss_ct))
  
  tss_win <- resize(tss_ct, width = 2L*window_bp + 1L, fix = "center")
  hits <- findOverlaps(peaks_ct, tss_win, ignore.strand = TRUE)
  
  if (!length(hits)) {
    data.table::fwrite(data.table(), out_tsv, sep = "\t")
    stop("No peak–gene pairs within ±", window_bp, " bp for ", key)
  }
  
  Q <- queryHits(hits)
  S <- subjectHits(hits)
  res <- data.table::data.table(
    cell_type  = key,
    peak_id    = names(peaks_ct)[Q],
    gene_id    = names(tss_ct)[S],
    peak_chr   = as.character(GenomicRanges::seqnames(peaks_ct))[Q],
    peak_start = GenomicRanges::start(peaks_ct)[Q],
    peak_end   = GenomicRanges::end(peaks_ct)[Q],
    gene_chr   = as.character(GenomicRanges::seqnames(tss_ct))[S],
    tss        = GenomicRanges::start(tss_ct)[S]
  )
  
  out_tsv <- file.path("output", "candidates", paste0("candidates_", key, ".tsv"))
  dir.create(dirname(out_tsv), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  fwrite(res, out_tsv, sep = "\t")
  message("Wrote candidates: ", out_tsv, " (", nrow(res), " rows)")
}

```
